articles.title: Should Qualcomm Stock Holders Look At First Solar Instead?
articles.description: Qualcomm (QCOM) and First Solar (FSLR) are both filed under semiconductors, and each holds patents that competitors want to use. On October 5, 2026, Huawei announced it had agreed to a multi-year patent licensing deal with Qualcomm. Meanwhile, the U.S. solar panel maker First Solar is actively suing rivals over its own patent rights.
